finding.finding: Current verified observations: Beruwala grid power is unavailable; Padukka grid power is unavailable; the Homagama-to-Padukka backhaul link is down. No equipment or road condition is established.

S01 has verified loss of grid power; S02 and S09 power status and links L08/L09 remain unresolved. The catalogue has equipment, backhaul, and generator actions, but no crews have backhaul skill, so link repair actions cannot be staffed with the listed crews. No road closures or other evidenced safety/impossibility grounds are supplied. Unknown status is not a reason to hold work.

finding.finding: POLICY-001 assigns weight 5 to V09 at S09 (Padukka) and weight 1 to all other services; these approved weights are unchanged. The authoritative snapshots report power failures at S01 (Beruwala) and S09 (Padukka), and a down transmission path from S08 (Homagama) to S09. S01's power failure affects its downstream subtree, including S02 and S03; S09 is also affected by its own power failure and the reported path outage. findings: V2-07-OBS-01 identifies BER87 as Beruwala (S01) and establishes grid_power_ok=false; it does not establish equipment status.
V2-07-OBS-02 identifies PAD85 as Padukka (S09), not Aluthgama (S02). The extracted fact assigning grid_power_ok=false to S02 is a wrong-target fact; Padukka's grid status remains unknown.

V2-07-OBS-03 establishes that the HOM12-to-PAD85 link (L08) is down. The claim that it is L08 is consistent with the directory; L09 remains unresolved, not established by this report. The link outage does not establish either endpoint's equipment or power status beyond what other evidence states; Padukka's grid status remains unknown as well as unresolved in the plan's list, while the reported grid fact is attributed to S02 incorrectly. The extracted fact list should be corrected, but no fact_challenge is available for a link or target-only issue; this report identifies the discrepancy for human review.
